title: Data Engineer
description:
DATA ENGINEER
UP TO £50,000
LONDON

This is an exciting opportunity for a Data Engineer to join a technology-driven organisation. You'll have the chance to build modern data platforms from the ground up, support AI-focused initiatives, and work across a range of high-profile client projects. You'll play a key role in shaping the future of the data engineering capability.


THE COMPANY

Our client is a well-established organisation operating at the intersection of data, technology and customer experience. They partner with a range of global brands to deliver innovative, data-led solutions across analytics, marketing and digital transformation. You'll join a collaborative team working closely with Data Science and business stakeholders to solve complex data challenges.


THE ROLE

Responsibilities include but are not limited to:

  • Build and maintain modern data platforms and scalable data pipelines
  • Develop cloud-based data solutions
  • Support AI-enabled initiatives and emerging data products
  • Help establish engineering best practices
  • Support data modelling, reporting and analytics requirements


YOUR SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

  • Strong commercial experience with Python, SQL and cloud-based data platforms is essential
  • Experience in marketing, advertising or media sectors is highly desirable
  • Strong communication skills and ability to engage with stakeholders
  • Experience with Snowflake, Microsoft Fabric and/or BigQuery is highly desirable


SALARY AND BENEFITS

  • Up to £50,000 base salary
  • Contributory pension scheme


HOW TO APPLY

Please register your interest to Mia Randhawa by sending your CV through the 'Apply' link
